findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_order, read_reviews · Private data: ask_impossibrew, build_shop_link · Public sink: check_order, cancel_order, change_delivery_address, skip_next_delivery, pause_subscription, resume_subscription, cancel_subscription, add_to_subscription, report_order_problem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_order, read_reviews · Private data: ask_impossibrew, build_shop_link · Public sink: check_order, cancel_order, change_delivery_address, skip_next_delivery, pause_subscription, resume_subscription, cancel_subscription, add_to_subscription, report_order_problem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
